titulo.alumno: A reference in the text · Compound words and references

intro: Part 2: a reference in the text. Notice which form expresses the relationship and go back to the sentence to check it.

texto: In Danish, many words are joined together and the last element usually determines the type of thing: «arbejdsplads» is a workplace. For a reference, look for the noun to which «den», «det» or «de» point back.
Notice which form expresses the relationship and go back to the sentence to check it.
